text.tspan: FRAME — Curt lays the two 26 August reports and the
Black Hat talk, the book's whole public account, on one
side of the desk. On the other side, the 4 September
report. Between them, a blank lane on the page plan with
the label he gave it on page 109.
DIALOGUE — CURT — “It was public the whole time and
I did not find it. Nobody did, until four people went looking.
Public is not the same as disclosed. I am not the one who
was owed an account, and the question stands anyway.”

g.text: MISSING FROM THE ACCOUNT · PANEL 1 · PLACEHOLDER
